summary: Iter 123z · Verified both fixes: (a) DocumentPreview modal opens with blob-URL src that resolves via authed axios GET to /api/uploads/{id} — 4/4 registration docs (photo, aadhaar, birth cert, marksheet PDF) rendered inline in the iframe with HTTP 200 + application/pdf, no 401s, no broken previews; (b) Player-Registrations audit trail timestamps now render as 'DD MMM YY, HH:MM' (e.g. '22 Aug 26, 21:13') with full ISO string in the span title. Backend regression pytest confirms /api/uploads/{id} is still JWT-gated (401 no-token, 200 with-token, 404 for bogus id after auth) and full upload-then-fetch round-trip works. No regression observed in the review-pane experience.
critical_code_review_comments: components/DocumentPreview.jsx line 101 has a latent bug: `{isImage(url) ? ... }` calls `isImage` as a function but at line 79 `isImage` is declared as a boolean (`const isImage = isImageByUrl(url) || sniffedType === 'image'`). This throws TypeError if the default trigger is ever rendered. Currently every caller (PlayerRegistrations, PlayerDetail, MeetingDetail) passes `renderTrigger`, so the default branch is dormant — but it's a footgun. Fix: use `isImageByUrl(url)` or just `isImage` (no parens).

PlayerRegistrations passes `hideExport` to DocumentPreview, which suppresses the New-Tab and Download buttons inside the modal AND the PDF viewer's built-in toolbar (`#toolbar=0&navpanes=0`). If the review-pane spec truly requires reviewers to be able to download/open-in-new-tab, `hideExport` should be dropped for that call-site. If the intent is to prevent casual downloads of KYC docs, the current behaviour is correct — flagging for clarity, not as a bug.
